title: Pilot safety policy contracts
description: The frozen wire shapes of the safety layer (C10): the decision events appended to policy.log, and the secrets store file shape. Matcher and policy config shapes live in config-pilot.schema.json.

decisionEvent.description: One line of the append-only JSONL decision log (C10).

tool.description: Tool the decision was made about.

detail.description: Matcher or host named by the decision; never a secret value.

session.description: Id of the session the decision was made in.

secretsFile.description: The secrets store: a JSON map of {name: value}, permission 0600. Values are injected at connectors and scrubbed from observations (C10); only names are ever shown to the model.
